The user is asking about the novel that the longest running show in Broadway history is based on, and who wrote it.

The longest running show in Broadway history is "The Phantom of the Opera" which opened in 1988 and closed in 2023 after 35 years. It was based on the novel "Le Fantôme de l'Opéra" (The Phantom of the Opera) by Gaston Leroux, published in 1910.
